channel.title: Rachit Mangawa - Engineering & Systems Feed
channel.description: Technical updates, low-latency systems, AI retrieval pipelines, and open source releases by Rachit Mangawa.

item.title: HeartFlow OS: Edge AI Telemetry & C99 Transpiler
item.description: Deterministic Edge AI runtime compiling Scikit-Learn soft-voting ensembles into zero-malloc C99 headers (<512B stack, 8.15KB SRAM) for microcontrollers, paired with a 60 FPS Web Serial oscillograph.

item.title: Vera AI Engine: 4-Tier Resilient LLM Cascade
item.description: High-availability AI orchestrator with a 4-tier fail-fast fallback cascade (NVIDIA NIM, Groq, Gemini, Local Qwen via llama-cpp-python with LlamaGrammar) and sub-millisecond context distillation.

item.title: Semantic Comment Analyzer: Sub-15ms NLP Intent Platform
item.description: Dense vector intent classification (MiniLM-L6-v2 + L2 logistic head) delivering sub-15ms CPU latency with exact token occlusion explainability.

item.title: TensorFlow Core: Numerical Autodiff Limit Fix
item.description: Patched math_grad.py for true limit handling in tf.math.bessel_i1 autodiff at x=0 with Python and C++ unit regression tests.
